exposure: dynamic contrast-enhanced magnetic resonance imaging (DC-MRI) findings
outcome: Characteristics of idiopathic granulomatous mastitis (IGM) as detected by breast ultrasound and DC-MRI
cohort: The cohort consisted of 42 female patients who had been histopathologically diagnosed with idiopathic granulomatous mastitis (IGM).
finding: Specific findings on breast ultrasound (US) such as heterogeneous hypoechoic lesions, tubular expansion, cystic components, floating debris, and ductal ectasia, and on breast MRI such as regionally distributed heterogeneous or clustered internal pattern, non-mass contrast enhancement, minimal background staining, and localized collective or micro-abscesses, are largely supportive of an idiopathic granulomatous mastitis (IGM) diagnosis.
